issues.t: Spark plug blown out of the head
issues.sym: A sudden loud popping or ticking, a misfire and a check engine light. The coil may be pushed up out of place.
issues.why: The aluminum heads hold each plug with only a few threads, so a plug can work loose and get blown out, damaging the threads.
issues.next: Stop driving and have it inspected, since a loose plug can also start a fire. Thread inserts are a common repair. Ask for correct plug torque at every tune-up.

issues.t: Cruise control deactivation switch can catch fire (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell, smoke from the driver side of the engine bay, or brake lights or cruise control that stop working. A fire can start even with the truck parked.
issues.why: The switch that cancels cruise control when you brake could leak brake fluid into its electrical side and overheat. Ford recalled the trucks to add a fused wiring kit.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it done before driving or parking the truck near a building.

issues.t: Steering shaft joint can separate (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking or play in the steering before it lets go.
issues.why: The steering intermediate shaft yoke could separate from the steering gear, causing a loss of steering. Ford recalled the trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. Stop driving if the steering feels loose.

issues.t: Rear track bar bracket can break off (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the rear and a rear end that shifts side to side or wanders.
issues.why: The bracket that holds the rear axle track bar to the frame could separate. Ford recalled the trucks to repair it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and stop driving if the rear clunks or wanders.

issues.t: Wheel lug nuts may loosen (recalls)
issues.sym: A clicking or clunking from a wheel, or a vibration that gets worse.
issues.why: The lug nuts on some trucks did not clamp the wheel tightly enough, so a wheel could loosen and in the worst case come off. Ford recalled the trucks to re-torque or replace the parts.
issues.next: Stop driving if a wheel clicks or wobbles. Check the VIN for these recalls.

issues.t: Shift cable can come loose (recall)
issues.sym: The shifter will not go into Park, or the gear shown does not match the gear the truck is in.
issues.why: The shift cable could detach from its bracket. The truck could then roll away when parked. Ford recalled the trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Use the parking brake every time and check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Trailer hitch bolts can loosen (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the hitch while towing, or a hitch that moves.
issues.why: The bolts that hold the factory trailer hitch could lose their clamping force. Ford recalled the trucks to fix them.
issues.next: Do not tow until the hitch is checked. Look up the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Fuel line may leak (recall)
issues.sym: A raw fuel smell or drips under the truck.
issues.why: Some fuel line assemblies were damaged during manufacturing and could leak, which is a fire risk. Ford recalled the trucks to replace them.
issues.next: Do not drive if you smell fuel. Check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Brake pushrod clip may be missing (recall)
issues.sym: A brake pedal that feels odd or a loss of braking.
issues.why: The clip that keeps the brake master cylinder pushrod in place may be missing or only partly installed. Ford recalled the trucks to inspect them.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have it done. Do not drive if the pedal feels wrong.

issues.t: Firestone Wilderness AT tires can separate (campaign)
issues.sym: Vibration, a bulge in a tire, or a sudden tread separation at highway speed.
issues.why: Ford replaced Firestone Wilderness AT tires on these trucks because their tread could separate.
issues.next: If the truck still has old tires of that type, replace them. Tires this old should be replaced anyway.

issues.t: Wiper motor switch can overheat (recall)
issues.sym: Wipers that stop working, often in heavy use.
issues.why: A switch inside the wiper motor gear case could overheat and cut the wipers. Ford recalled the trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Do not drive in rain or snow without working wipers. Check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Running board light wiring can overheat (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell or melted wiring near the running boards, or courtesy lights that act up.
issues.why: Wiring for the running board courtesy lights could overheat. Ford recalled the trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it repaired if you notice any burning smell.

issues.t: Driver airbag and seat belt buckle defects (recalls)
issues.sym: A seat belt that does not latch firmly, or no warning at all for the airbag fault.
issues.why: Ford recalled 2001 trucks because some driver airbag inflators had weak welds and some front seat belt buckles might not fully latch.
issues.next: Check the VIN for both recalls and get them fixed.

issues.t: Spark plugs break during removal
issues.sym: No symptoms until a tune-up, when plugs seize and snap off in the head. Misfires can show up if plugs are overdue.
issues.why: The two-piece plug design builds up carbon and rust and can seize in the head. Ford published a special removal tool and procedure.
issues.next: Use a shop that knows the Ford removal procedure, and do not stretch the plug change interval.

issues.t: Cam phaser and timing chain rattle
issues.sym: Rattling or knocking from the front of the engine, worst at idle or on cold starts, with a rough idle or check engine light.
issues.why: The oil-driven cam phasers and chain tensioners wear and timing chains stretch, especially with skipped oil changes or low oil pressure.
issues.next: Have it diagnosed soon, since a failing timing system can wreck the engine. Use the correct oil and change it on time.

issues.t: Wiper motor gear may lack grease (recall)
issues.sym: Wipers that slow down or stop.
issues.why: The wiper motor gear may have been built without enough grease, so the wipers could fail. Ford recalled the trucks to fix them.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. Do not drive in bad weather without working wipers.

issues.t: Factory tires may have tread damage (recall)
issues.sym: Vibration, a bulge or a sudden tread separation.
issues.why: Some tires were damaged during production and could lose tread. Ford recalled the trucks to replace them.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and inspect the tires. Replace any tire with a bulge.

issues.t: Fuel rail crossover hose can crack (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell under the hood or fuel drips at the top of the engine.
issues.why: The hose that links the two fuel rails could crack and leak fuel onto the engine, which is a fire risk. Ford recalled the trucks to replace it.
issues.next: Do not drive if you smell fuel. Check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Inside door handle spring can break (recall)
issues.sym: A door handle that feels loose or does not spring back.
issues.why: A spring retainer in the inside door handle could fracture, which could let the door open in a side crash. Ford recalled the trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it done.

issues.t: Driver airbag module may be assembled wrong (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning. The airbag light may come on.
issues.why: Some driver airbag modules were assembled incorrectly and might not work properly in a crash. Ford recalled the trucks to replace them.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it done.

issues.t: Tire pressure warning set too low (recall)
issues.sym: The low tire pressure light does not come on until a tire is quite low.
issues.why: The tire pressure monitor was not updated for the higher pressure tires fitted to some trucks. Ford recalled the trucks to reprogram it.
issues.next: Check tire pressures by hand monthly and look up the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Brake lights may not come on (recall)
issues.sym: Other drivers tell you the brake lights are out, or the cruise control will not cancel properly.
issues.why: The brake light switch could be out of adjustment, delaying or preventing the brake lights. Ford recalled the trucks to adjust it.
issues.next: Have someone check your brake lights and look up the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Sudden downshift to first gear or no reverse (recalls)
issues.sym: A sudden hard downshift into first gear at speed, or the truck will not go into reverse or the reverse lights stay off.
issues.why: Ford recalled 2012 trucks for a transmission problem that could cause an unexpected downshift to first gear, and separately for a range sensor that could be calibrated wrong.
issues.next: Check the VIN for both recalls. If the transmission downshifts on its own, slow down gently and get it checked before driving again.

issues.t: Front blower motor can overheat (recall)
issues.sym: A burning or hot plastic smell from the vents, smoke, or a fan that stops working.
issues.why: The front blower motor could fail in a way that creates a fire risk inside the cabin. Ford recalled the trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Turn the fan off if you smell burning and check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Backup camera image distorted or blank (recalls)
issues.sym: The rearview camera shows a distorted, upside-down, or blank picture.
issues.why: A loose or damaged camera connector, or a fault in the camera, could ruin the image. Ford recalled the trucks to repair it.
issues.next: Use mirrors and look back when reversing, and check the VIN for these recalls.

issues.t: Brake master cylinder can leak into the booster (recalls)
issues.sym: A brake warning light, a low brake fluid level, or a pedal that goes lower than normal.
issues.why: Fluid could leak from the master cylinder into the brake booster, cutting braking from part of the system. Ford recalled the trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Do not drive if the brake light is on or the pedal sinks. Check the VIN for these recalls.

issues.t: High-pressure fuel pump can leak (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell under the hood.
issues.why: Welds on the engine's high-pressure fuel pump could crack and leak fuel, which is a fire risk. Ford recalled the trucks to replace it.
issues.next: Do not drive if you smell fuel. Check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Park may not hold or gear may not match the shifter (recalls)
issues.sym: The truck rolls after being put in Park, or the gear shown does not match the gear selected.
issues.why: Ford recalled 2018 trucks because a missing roll pin could cost the transmission its park function, and because a shift cable clip may not have been fully seated.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake and check the VIN for both recalls.

issues.t: Harsh or erratic 10-speed shifts
issues.sym: Hard, jerky or delayed shifts, clunks, or a pause while accelerating, mostly at low speed.
issues.why: The 10R80 10-speed automatic shared with the F-150 has been the subject of bulletins and lawsuits over harsh upshifts, downshifts and engagements.
issues.next: Ask a Ford dealer to check for software updates and bulletins for your VIN.

issues.t: Park pawl can engage while moving (recall)
issues.sym: A loud grinding or clunk, or a sudden lurch, and later a truck that does not hold in Park.
issues.why: The transmission park pawl could engage while the truck is still moving, which damages the park system and can lead to a rollaway. Ford recalled the trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake and check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Front seat belt can lock in place (recalls)
issues.sym: A front seat belt that stays locked and will not pull out or retract.
issues.why: The seat belt pretensioner could trigger and lock the belt. Ford recalled the trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for these recalls. Have a locked belt repaired before carrying a passenger in that seat.

issues.t: Center console trim can peel and leave sharp edges (recall)
issues.sym: Chrome-look plating on the center console peels or flakes.
issues.why: The plating on the console trim could peel off and leave sharp edges. Ford recalled the trucks to replace it.
issues.next: Avoid touching the peeling edge and check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Rear toe link bolts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the rear, wandering, or a change in how the truck steers.
issues.why: Fasteners on the rear toe links may not have been tightened properly, so a link could separate. Ford recalled the trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Stop driving if the rear clunks or wanders. Check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Shift-to-park warning too short (recalls)
issues.sym: The warning chime and message when you open the door without being in Park end too quickly.
issues.why: The reminder that warns you the truck is not in Park did not last long enough, raising the risk of a rollaway. Ford recalled the trucks, then recalled them again after some repairs were done wrong.
issues.next: Always confirm the truck is in Park and set the parking brake. Check the VIN for both recalls.

issues.t: Seat recliner may be missing a part (recall)
issues.sym: A seatback that feels loose or moves.
issues.why: Some seat recliners were built without a required pawl, so the seatback may not hold in a crash. Ford recalled the trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Shift cable clip may not be seated (recall)
issues.sym: The gear the truck is in does not match the shifter, or it may not stay in Park.
issues.why: A shift cable clip may not have been fully installed. Ford recalled the trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake and check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Pre-collision assist may be switched off (recalls)
issues.sym: Automatic emergency braking does not work, sometimes with a warning message.
issues.why: A software coding error could leave pre-collision assist disabled. Ford recalled the trucks, and recalled some again after an incorrect repair.
issues.next: Do not count on automatic braking until the VIN shows both recalls done.

issues.t: Battery junction box can short and start a fire (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke from the engine bay, sometimes with the truck off.
issues.why: A short in the battery junction box could cause an engine compartment fire. Ford told owners to park outside until the repair was done.
issues.next: Park outside and away from buildings until the VIN shows this recall repaired.

issues.t: Backup camera blank, frozen or delayed (recalls)
issues.sym: The rearview camera shows nothing, freezes, lags, or stays on screen.
issues.why: Ford recalled these trucks several times for camera wiring and software faults that could blank, distort or freeze the rear image.
issues.next: Use mirrors and look back when reversing, and check the VIN for open camera recalls.

issues.t: Windshield wiper arms can break (recalls)
issues.sym: A wiper arm snaps or stops wiping in rain or snow.
issues.why: The wiper arms could crack and break. Ford recalled the trucks to replace them.
issues.next: Do not drive in bad weather without working wipers. Check the VIN for these recalls.

issues.t: Engine compartment fire risk (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke from under the hood.
issues.why: Ford recalled these trucks for an engine compartment fire risk and told owners to park outside until it was fixed.
issues.next: Park outside and away from buildings until the VIN shows this recall repaired.

issues.t: Side impact sensors may be damaged (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light may come on.
issues.why: Side impact sensors may have been damaged, so the side airbags might not deploy correctly. Ford recalled the trucks to replace them.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it done.

issues.t: Moonroof wind deflector can come loose (recall)
issues.sym: Wind noise or rattling from the moonroof, or a deflector that is missing.
issues.why: The clips holding the moonroof wind deflector could let go. Ford recalled the trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: Stumbling, loss of power, stalling while driving, or a no-start.
issues.why: The low-pressure fuel pump could fail. Ford recalled the trucks to replace it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. Stop driving if the engine starts losing power.

issues.t: Trailer brakes or lights may stop working (recalls)
issues.sym: A trailer warning message, trailer lights that go out, or trailer brakes that do not apply.
issues.why: Ford recalled these trucks for trailer brake controller software errors and for a trailer module that can lose communication with the truck.
issues.next: Check the trailer lights and brakes before every tow, and check the VIN for open recalls.

issues.t: Front brake line can rub through and leak (recall)
issues.sym: A brake warning light, low brake fluid or a soft pedal.
issues.why: A front brake line could rub against an air cleaner pipe and wear through. Ford recalled the trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Do not drive if the brake light is on or the pedal feels soft. Check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Front axle pinion can break (recall)
issues.sym: A grinding or clunking from the front axle, or a loss of four-wheel-drive power.
issues.why: Some front axle pinions may have missed heat treatment and could fracture. Ford recalled the trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. Stop driving if the front axle grinds or clunks.

issues.t: Engine plug can let oil out fast (recalls)
issues.sym: A sudden oil leak, smoke, an oil pressure warning, or engine noise.
issues.why: A cup plug in the engine may have been misaligned and could push out, causing a rapid oil leak. Ford recalled the trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Shut the engine off right away if the oil pressure warning comes on. Check the VIN for these recalls.

issues.t: Brake booster can lose power assist (recalls)
issues.sym: A hard brake pedal, a brake warning, and longer stopping distances.
issues.why: The electronic brake booster or its module could malfunction and cut power assist. Ford recalled the trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Pull over safely if the pedal goes hard and check the VIN for these recalls.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may deploy too hard (recall)
issues.sym: No warning to the driver.
issues.why: The front passenger airbag could deploy with more force than intended. Ford recalled the trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it done.

issues.t: LED headlights can cut out (recall)
issues.sym: Headlight functions drop out or flicker while driving.
issues.why: Contaminated LED chips in the headlamps could cause headlight functions to fail. Ford recalled the trucks to fix them.
issues.next: Avoid night driving if a headlight cuts out and check the VIN for this recall.
